fact: COBAC's 2025 annual report, as relayed by Ecomatin, counts seven licensed payment institutions (etablissements de paiement) in CEMAC in 2025, of which Orange Money Cameroun and Mobile Money Corporation SA (MTN) operate in Cameroon; the source names no law or regulation by title.

Konoom Cameroun was licensed as a payment institution (etablissement de paiement) by arrete n°681/MINFI of 21 July 2026, following COBAC decision n°D-2026/092; Orange Money Cameroun and Mobile Money Corporation (MTN) were already licensed, per DGTCFM data of July 2026; the source names no law by title.

Agence Ecofin states that Cameroon's regulatory framework lets payment institutions and also banks and microfinance institutions offer payment services under the conditions the regulation sets; published 2026-09-17, the source gives no date for the framework and names no law by title.

CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC Regulation 04/18 of 21 December 2018 on payment services imposes opposition and blocking means, a permanent complaints mechanism and transaction authenticity solutions, and mobile money falls under it.

The Prime Minister's order of 28 May 2025 cites CEMAC regulation 03/16/CEMAC/UMAC/CM of 21 December 2016 on payment systems and incidents as a legal basis, alongside a finance ministry order of 28 February 2024 on approving electronic payment service providers.
